cost.basis: GPU-time estimate from v1.8.0: one monthly-rented RTX PRO 6000 96 GB, USD 1.5235/hour; average load 70%. Architecture: small qwen, 4B active parameters; throughput 61525 tokens/s (architecture-class calibration, efficient-engine prefill). GPU-time cost USD 0.00749165771629108/1,000; old list-price estimate USD 0.0228722498321021/1,000 (deepinfra:Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B at USD 0.03/M input and USD 0.15/M output). Applied min(old list-price estimate, GPU-time cost) = USD 0.00749165771629108/1,000. Estimated, not a bill.

starlord-4b-preview.disclosure: Paid public evaluation. Measured on the 27 Oct draw on an evaluator-owned rented GPU, offline with the author's serving stack at the pinned commit. Failed or unanswered requests count as wrong answers. Qwen3.5-4B finetune read out through candidate logits in one joint forward pass, 0 output tokens, with a two-block bidirectional attention pass over the request in the full-attention layers and short-input repetition (<= 3,000 tokens). The model card says the public JevBench split was used for evaluation and tuning, not training. Over-limit or OOM items refused with 422 and scored wrong.

draw.ci_basis: measured on the draw before equating
draw.label: Third regular draw

starlord-4b-preview.endpoint_condition: evaluator-owned Verda GPU VM (RTXPRO6000), offline read-only container (--network none); customer's inference/serve_systemone.py unchanged at model commit 53321bdd; one BF16 model instance, candidate-logit readout (FP32 softmax, T=1.0), no generation, no KV cache; full-attention layers run the author's two-block bidirectional FlashAttention (flash-attn 2.8.3 varlen: request prefix attends to the prefix, the rest to the whole request); JevBench input repetition as in the model card (complete user input repeated once when the encoded request is <= 3,000 tokens); linear-attention (GDN) layers causal via fla 0.4.1 kernels; customer limit 131,072 tokens per joint request (no truncation, HTTP 422 above or on GPU OOM); official PyTorch 2.10.0 cu130 image + pinned overlay (transformers 5.3.0, official flash-attn 2.8.3 cu13/torch2.10 release wheel, Python 3.12) + decision_index base classes @25c6ec7b
